content.hebrew: אֲלֵיכֶם אֶקְרָא, אִישִׁים,
content.transliteration: Alekhem eḳra, ishim,
content.english: To you, people, do I call out:

content.hebrew: הִתְקֹשְׁשׁוּ וָקֹֽשּׁוּ, אֲנָשִׁים וְנָשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Hitḳosheshu vaḳosh’shu, anashim venashim.
content.english: Gather yourselves and assemble, men and women.

content.hebrew: רִדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי מוֹת – תִּהְיוּ קְדֹשִׁים!
content.transliteration: Ridfu aḥarē mot – tihyu ḳedoshim!
content.english: Pursue afterdeath—be holy!

content.hebrew: נֶֽצַח בְּמִצְוֹת אֵל הֱיוּ חָשִׁים,
content.transliteration: Netsaḥ bemitsvot El heyu ḥashim,
content.english: Be forever diligent in God’s commandments,

content.hebrew: כִּי הֵם לְכָל־חֶפְצֵיהֶם דְּרוּשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Ki hem lekhol ḥeftsehem derushim.
content.english: For they are sought out by all who desire them.

content.hebrew: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֱלִילִים, פַּח יְקוּשִׁים,
content.transliteration: Al tifnu el ha’elilim, paḥ yeḳushim,
content.english: Do not turn to the false gods, you who are caught in a trap.

content.hebrew: עַקְּרוּ יֵֽצֶר לֵב, וּמִזְבַּח תְּשׁוּבָה – זִבְחֵי אִשִּׁים.
content.transliteration: ‘aḳḳeru yetser lev, umizbaḥ teshuva – zivḥē ish’shim.
content.english: Tear out the heart’s inclination, [for] the altar of repentance is [reckoned as] sacrifices, fire offerings.

content.hebrew: אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ לֹא תִהְיוּ מְכַחֲשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Ish ba‘amito lo tihyu mekhaḥashim.
content.english: No one should deceive their fellow.

content.hebrew: שֵׁם אֵל יְראוּ, הוֹד וִיקָר חֲבוּשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Shem El yir’u, hod viḳar ḥavushim.
content.english: Fear God’s name, you who are wrapped in splendor and glory.

content.hebrew: מֵי אַהֲבָה לְאַח הַשְׁקוּ, וְאַל נָא תִּהְיוּ נְטוּשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Mē ahava le’aḥ hashḳu, ve’al na tihyu netushim.
content.english: Supply waters of love to your brother, and do not be rejected.

content.hebrew: וְכִלְאֵי מַחֲשָׁבָה בְּזוּ, וְהָאֱמֶת הֱיוּ מְבַקְשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Vekhil’ē maḥashava bezu, veha’emet heyu mevaḳshim.
content.english: Spurn hybrid thoughts, and be seekers of truth.

content.hebrew: לָֽמָּה תְגוֹאֲלוּ, בַּעֲוֹן הַגְּוִיָּה, הַנְּפָשִׁים,
content.transliteration: Lamma teḡo’alu, ba‘avon haggeviyya, hannefashim,
content.english: Why should you be defiled, souls, with the sin of the body,

content.hebrew: עַרְלֵי לֵב כְּעָרְלַת פְּרִי עֵץ, אֲטוּמִים וְקָשִׁים?
content.transliteration: ‘arlē lev ke‘orlat peri ‘ets, atumim veḳashim?
content.english: [By being] uncircumcised of heart, like the uncircumcision of tree-fruits, closed and hard?

content.hebrew: תְּנוּ לֵב לָבוֹא בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים,
content.transliteration: Tenu lev lavo behadrat ḳodesh haḳḳodashim,
content.english: Set your heart to come to the beauty of the holy of holies.

content.hebrew: יַחֲדוּ שְׁמוֹ תָמִיד, וּלְהַלְּלוֹ הֱיוּ נִגָּשִׁים,
content.transliteration: Yaḥadu shemo tamid, ulhallelo heyu niggashim,
content.english: Constantly declare the oneness of His name, and draw near to praise Him,

content.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אֶל עַמִּים יַהֲפֹךְ שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה, בְּלִי מָשִׁים,
content.transliteration: Ki hu el ‘ammim yahafokh safa verura, beli mashim,
content.english: For He will transform nations irrevocably [to speak] pure language,

content.hebrew: לְעָבְדוֹ שְׁכֶם אֶחָד יִהְיוּ דֹרְשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Le‘ovdo shekhem eḥad yihyu doreshim.
content.english: To worship Him with one shoulder, they will seek.

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהָיָה יוי לְמֶֽלֶךְ הַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכָל־רָאשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehaya Adonai lemelekh hammitnassē lekhol rashim.
content.english: Cong. And Adonai will be king, elevated above all.

content.hebrew: חזן: [וְהָיָ֧ה יו֛י לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ] בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֧ה יו֛י אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד: (זכריה יד:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Vehaya Adonai lemelekh ‘al kol ha’arets bayyom hahu yihyē Adonai eḥad ushmo eḥad:
content.english: Cantor: And Adonai will be king over the entire world; on that day, Adonai will be one, and His name one. (Zech. 14:9)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, Eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
